title: Act: Validate scene characters in validateWorld
summary: Check scene character ids, interaction dialogue and events in validateWorld.
description: In validateWorld's per-scene loop add a pass over scene.characters.
technical_constraints: Reuse checkEvents and the existing ctx object

steps.lines: after the `for (const node of scene.dialogue)` loop (about L141)
steps.action: Insert a loop over scene.characters ?? [] that pushes `unknown character: ${c.id}` when !characters.has(c.id), pushes `unknown dialogue: ${d}` when c.interaction?.dialogue is set and not in dialogueIds, and calls checkEvents(c.interaction?.events, ctx, errors).
steps.expected: validateWorld returns the new errors for bad NPCs and none for valid ones.
